1.explanation:
• DataTable/README.md – shows how DataTable wires up pagination and which props control pages per view and total pages.
• DataTable/stories – contains the story (pagination-data-table) that reproduces the long dropdown issue with sample data and pagination settings.
• DataTable/state – contains the internal pagination state handlers that calculate page counts, current page, and hook into the Select component.
• Pagination/README.md – documents the Pagination component API, including how the page selector is implemented (via Select) and any available configuration.
• Select/README.md – covers the Select component’s behavior, including its dropdown rendering logic and limitations when given large option sets.
• NumberInput/migrate-to-7.x.md – describes how to configure and use NumberInput (the recommended control for direct page entry) so you can replace the Select with a text/number input to jump to pages directly.
1.bug_scenario: The DataTable’s pagination control renders its page‐selector as a Carbon Select component with one option per page. In tables with many pages (e.g. ~69 pages) the Select’s dropdown list extends far beyond the viewport, so users must scroll through an extremely long list to jump to a page. The dropdown isn’t constrained by the browser window, resulting in a poor UX. The expected behavior is to allow direct entry of a page number (e.g. via TextInput or NumberInput) rather than a huge Select list.
